title: Moya-xiviri wa Yindlu yo Kwetsima
intro: Eka matluka ya Quran, xifaniso xi huma eka rixaka ra muprofeta lonkulu, loyi a nyikiwaka tanihi nyiko loko a dyuharile. Moya lowu wu tlangeriwa hikwalaho ka ntiyiso lowu nga tsekatsekiki ni xiphemu lexikulu eku simekeni ka ndhawu yo kwetsima leyi a yi ta va rivoni ra ripfumelo. Loko u ri karhi u hlaya swikombiso, yingisela hi vukheta rito leri humaka enkarhini lowu hundzeke, hikuva ri vulavula hi munhu wo sungula.
clues: Ndzi boxiwile eka Quran etlhelo ka muprofeta un’wana tanihi nyiko leyi nyikiweke murhumiwa la dyuhaleke.
A ndzi ri un’wana wa vana vambirhi lava nyikiweke muprofeta yoloye emalembeni yakwe ya le ndzhaku.
Ndzi dzunisiwa eka Quran hi ku va ndzi ri ntiyiso eka rito ra mina.
Ndzi rhwale ku xiximiwa ka vuprofeta naswona ndzi rhumeriwe tanihi murhumiwa.
Ndzi joyine tatana eku tlakuseni ka masungulo ya Yindlu yo Kwetsima.
Ndzi tsundzukiwa tanihi un’wana wa lava lehisaka mbilu, naswona yindlu yo kwetsima leyi hi yi akeke yi hundzuke ndhawu yo vuyela ni ku sirheleleka eka vanhu.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
